capabilities.description: Use when the request asks whether one declared claim holds for a particular scope and version.
capabilities.label: Check a scoped claim

capabilities.description: Use when the request asks which source records are attached to an item in a scope and version.
capabilities.label: Find supporting records

capabilities.description: Use when the request explicitly requires strict policy, conflict handling, or an auditable rule trace.
capabilities.label: Resolve claim with policy rules

capabilities.description: Use for deterministic greater-than, less-than, or equal-to threshold checks.
capabilities.label: Compare a value to a threshold

capabilities.description: Use only after a structured result already exists and the request asks for an explanation.
capabilities.label: Explain an existing result

capabilities.description: Use when the requested operation cannot be executed safely without a scope.
capabilities.label: Ask which scope applies

capabilities.description: Use when the requested operation cannot be executed safely without a version.
capabilities.label: Ask which version applies

capabilities.description: Use when no declared capability matches the requested goal.
capabilities.label: Clarify the requested operation

capabilities.description: Use when the request would modify database, policy, files, or other protected state.
capabilities.label: Reject write or mutation request
